scope: China non-squamous NSCLC; separate stage-specific treatment contexts; detailed index cohort is EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic disease after EGFR-TKI progression
source_capture: LINK_AND_METADATA_ONLY; no independently archived source-byte hashes claimed

claims.statement: Surgery is a stage-specific treatment pathway and an operated Chinese NSCLC cohort exists
claims.limits: Operated stage IA-IIIA patients are not exchangeable with advanced post-TKI trial patients; non-squamous subgroup must be verified before subgroup estimates

claims.statement: Ivonescimab with pemetrexed and carboplatin was approved in China for EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC progressing after EGFR-TKI
In HARMONi-A final analysis, trial-group median OS was 16.8 vs 14.1 months, HR 0.74 (95% CI 0.58-0.95), in randomized groups of 161 each
claims.limits: Randomized drug comparison only; no personal forecast or cross-modality ranking

claims.statement: An ECMO hospital-record study counted 2073 cases in 1700 Chinese tertiary hospitals in 2018
claims.limits: Authors could not distinguish disease-specific outcomes; no lung-cancer ECMO efficacy estimate

claims.statement: Lung transplantation for malignancy is discussed only for highly selected low-invasive lung-limited patterns
claims.limits: Not a treatment option established for the advanced post-TKI index cohort; local eligibility unverified

claims.statement: Hospital-specific drug exposure, dose modification, follow-up survival, adverse-event and patient-feedback dataset for this case
claims.limits: No hospital selected, no purchase, no rights or price asserted
